proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence.elapsed_days.regain omitted/null round-trip
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing elapsed_days family fits this item, but the Dhall worker emits an omitted field for None while the tracer only accepts null for the full-refill case. The surface needs one stable representation for 'full refill after N days' that survives Dhall-to-JSON and tracer consumption.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

notes: content/magic_item_tome_of_understanding.dhall and .json were authored successfully, and pnpm typecheck passed. Tracing failed because resetCadence.elapsed_days with full refill compiled to an omitted regain field, which the tracer treated as a DiceAmount instead of the existing full-refill sentinel.
